Engineering / Guide

Building durable interfaces

By Morgan Lee · 16 November 2026 · 4 minute read

Practical decisions for readable, adaptable product interfaces.

Begin with semantics

Start with meaningful HTML before adding presentation and behavior. Native controls carry built-in platform affordances.

Choose reusable patterns

Use shared design tokens and small compositions rather than one-off variants.

Design is a continuous maintenance decision.
